title: London Icons Express
description: Big Ben, royal palaces, and Thames-side charm

days.title: Westminster & Royal London
attractions: Big Ben & Palace of Westminster [iconic gothic parliament building with clock tower]
Westminster Abbey [Gothic church with royal coronations and royal tombs]
Buckingham Palace [official residence of monarch with changing of guards ceremony]
St. James's Park [royal park with lake and wildlife near palace]
Horse Guards Parade [historic military parade ground]
tips: Buy London Pass for unlimited transport and museum entries
Watch Changing of the Guard at 11:30am (Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Sunday)

days.title: Museums & South Bank
attractions: British Museum [world-famous museum with Egyptian mummies and Greek sculptures]
National Gallery [art museum with masterpieces by Van Gogh and Da Vinci]
Tower of London [medieval fortress with crown jewels and Beefeater guards]
Tower Bridge [iconic Victorian bridge with glass walkway]
South Bank [riverside promenade with London Eye views]
tips: Most major museums free entry; book timed slots online
Tower of London book ahead to skip queues

days.title: Shopping & Neighborhoods
attractions: Oxford Street [famous shopping boulevard with major brands]
Harrods Department Store [luxury shopping landmark in Knightsbridge]
Covent Garden [historic market with street performers and restaurants]
Borough Market [food market with international cuisine]
Camden Market [alternative market with vintage and indie shops]
tips: Borough Market best visited morning for fresh food and less crowds
Camden Market packed weekends; go weekday for better experience

title: England's Highlights Tour
description: London, Bath, and Stonehenge ancient mysteries

days.title: London Arrival
attractions: Big Ben & Houses of Parliament [gothic architecture and clock tower]
tips: Get Oyster Card for unlimited tube/bus travel
Stay in Zone 1-2 for easy access to attractions

days.title: Museums & Culture
attractions: Tower of London [medieval fortress with crown jewels]
Tower Bridge [iconic bridge with glass skywalk]
tips: Book British Museum and Tower of London online for fast entry
Globe Theatre tours available; Shakespeare plays sometimes staged

days.title: Stonehenge & Bath Day Trip
attractions: Stonehenge [mysterious prehistoric monument with massive stones]
Bath Roman Spa [ancient Roman bathing complex with museum]
tips: Train from London to Bath takes 1.5 hours
Visit Stonehenge early morning for fewer crowds and better light

days.title: Bath & Cotswolds
attractions: Roman Baths Museum [preserved ancient bathing complex]
Pulteney Bridge [elegant Georgian bridge over river]
Cotswolds Villages [honey-colored stone villages like Bourton-on-the-Water]
Blenheim Palace [UNESCO birthplace of Winston Churchill]
Oxford University [historic university colleges and gardens]
tips: Rent car or join tour to explore Cotswolds villages
Blenheim Palace requires several hours for full exploration

days.title: Oxford & Return
attractions: Oxford University Colleges [Christ Church, Bodleian Library, Trinity College]
Oxford Castle [medieval tower with views of city]
Botanical Garden [riverside garden with 4,000 plant species]
Punting on Cherwell [traditional flat-bottomed boat tours]
tips: Punting requires advance booking or can be done anytime
Visit college chapels during evensong for beautiful choir performances

title: Complete Britain Discovery
description: London, England, Scotland Edinburgh, Lake District

days.title: London Arrival & Westminster
attractions: Big Ben [clock tower and parliament building]
tips: Get London Pass for 3/6/10-day unlimited access
Stay near tube station for easy commute

days.title: Museums & Royal London
attractions: Tower of London [crown jewels and fortress]
tips: Book museums online for skip-the-line entry
St. Paul's evensong choir free entry

days.title: South London & Greenwich
attractions: Greenwich Observatory [prime meridian and ship models]
Thames Barrier [engineering marvel with visitor center]
tips: Use Thames Clipper boat from central London to Greenwich
Greenwich best for afternoon visit after museums

days.title: Stonehenge & Bath
tips: Train London to Bath 1.5 hours
Stonehenge sunrise visit spectacular but very early

days.title: Cotswolds Villages
attractions: Blenheim Palace [UNESCO palace and birthplace of Churchill]
Cotswold Water Park [scenic water and villages]
tips: Rent car to explore multiple villages in one day
Stay overnight in village for authentic experience

days.title: Oxford University
attractions: Oxford University Colleges [Christ Church, Magdalen, Trinity]
Punting on Cherwell [traditional boats on river]
tips: Visit colleges during undergraduate term for vibrant atmosphere
Book punting in advance or do spontaneously

days.title: Travel to Edinburgh
attractions: Train journey through countryside [scenic 6-hour journey with refreshments]
Edinburgh Castle [hilltop fortress with city views]
Royal Mile [historic street with shops and pubs]
Arthur's Seat [extinct volcano with panoramic views]
Holyrood Palace [official Scottish residence of monarch]
tips: Book train tickets in advance for better prices
Climb Arthur's Seat early morning for fewer crowds and best light

days.title: Edinburgh Culture
attractions: Edinburgh Castle [medieval fortress with crown jewels]
National Museum of Scotland [Scottish history and culture]
Greyfriars Kirkyard [historic graveyard and Harry Potter inspiration]
Camera Obscura [historic optical device with city views]
tips: Book castle tickets online for skip-the-line
Greyfriars Bobby statue popular selfie spot

days.title: Lake District Day Trip
attractions: Lake Windermere [largest lake with boat cruises]
Beatrix Potter Gallery [author's home and museum]
Mountain hiking [fells and peaks for trekking]
Local pubs [traditional ale and fish & chips]
tips: Train from Edinburgh to Lake District 3-4 hours
Book boat cruises in advance during peak season

days.title: Lake District & Return
attractions: Keswick [town with lake access and shops]
Derwent Water [scenic lake for boat tours]
tips: Early morning hike before afternoon train
Pack picnic for mountain walk

title: Dublin Charm Quick Escape
description: Guinness, Georgian architecture, and Irish culture

days.title: Dublin City Center
attractions: Temple Bar [historic quarter with pubs and restaurants]
Ha'penny Bridge [iconic cast-iron bridge over Liffey river]
Trinity College [historic university with Book of Kells]
Grafton Street [shopping street with street performers]
St. Stephen's Green [central park with museums nearby]
tips: Dublin very walkable; stay centrally for easy access
Book Temple Bar restaurants in advance; popular with tourists

days.title: Museums & Literary Dublin
attractions: Guinness Storehouse [brewery museum with rooftop bar with city views]
Book of Kells [illuminated medieval manuscript at Trinity]
Dublin Writers Museum [Joyce, Beckett, Wilde exhibits]
Smiths Tavern [historic pub for traditional music and Guinness]
tips: Book Guinness Storehouse online to skip queues
Live traditional music in pubs most evenings

days.title: Day Trips from Dublin
attractions: Wicklow Mountains [scenic mountain range with monasteries]
Cliffs of Moher [dramatic 230-meter cliffs [1.5 hour drive]]
Irish countryside [rural villages with green hills]
Local pubs [authentic Irish hospitality and food]
tips: Rent car for countryside exploration
Cliffs of Moher best on clear days for dramatic views

title: Ireland's Wild Atlantic Way
description: Dublin, Cliffs of Moher, Galway, and coastal beauty

days.title: Dublin City Exploration
attractions: Temple Bar Quarter [historic neighborhood with pubs]
Trinity College [university with Book of Kells]
tips: City center walkable and pedestrian friendly
Book museum tickets online for faster entry

days.title: Guinness & Museums
attractions: Guinness Storehouse [brewery with rooftop bar and city views]
Smiths Tavern [traditional music venue and authentic pub]
tips: Visit Guinness Storehouse at sunset for best rooftop light
Traditional music sessions nightly in many pubs

days.title: Drive to Cliffs of Moher
attractions: Wicklow Mountains [scenic mountain range south of Dublin]
Glendalough [valley with monastic ruins and lakes]
Doolin Village [cliff-side village with traditional music]
O'Brien's Tower [round tower on cliffs with coastal views]
tips: Rent car for flexibility in countryside
Cliffs best visited morning before afternoon crowds

days.title: Galway & Connemara
attractions: Galway City [bohemian coastal town with colorful buildings]
Shop Street [pedestrian area with shops and restaurants]
Kylemore Abbey [castle on lake in mountains]
tips: Galway 2 hours from Cliffs of Moher via scenic drive
Connemara known for traditional Irish culture and music

days.title: Aran Islands or Return
attractions: Aran Islands [three islands off coast with ancient sites and traditional culture]
Dun Aengus [prehistoric stone fort on island cliff]
Galway Seafood Festival [seasonal festival with local cuisine]
Return to Dublin [train or flight 2-3 hours]
tips: Ferry to Aran Islands from Galway or Doolin (45 mins)
Islands car-free; bring sturdy walking shoes

days.title: Dublin City Introduction
tips: Stay central for easy walking
Book accommodations in Temple Bar area

days.title: Dublin Museums & Culture
tips: Book Guinness online for fast track
Pubs best after 9pm for traditional sessions

days.title: Wicklow Day Trip
tips: Day tour from Dublin available
Glendalough best in morning light

days.title: Cliffs of Moher
tips: Early morning visit for fewer crowds
Can be windy and misty; bring layers

days.title: Galway & Connemara
tips: Rent car for mountain exploration
Traditional Irish music venues abundant

days.title: Aran Islands
attractions: Traditional island culture [horse carts, traditional dress]

No cars on islands; explore on foot or rent bike

Rent car for flexibility

days.title: Dingle Peninsula
attractions: Dingle Town [fishing village with colorful buildings]
Conor Pass [mountain pass with stunning views]

Slea Head Drive one of Ireland's most scenic routes

days.title: Cork & South Coast
attractions: Cork City [second-largest city with cultural vibe]
tips: Kinsale colorful and walkable; great seafood restaurants
Blarney Castle 10km from Cork, easy day trip

Last evening in Temple Bar [traditional music and farewell dinner]
Reflection on Irish culture [memories and connections]
